handoffs.task_title: Run Week 1 — indoor leash foundations, no other dogs at all
handoffs.evidence: GATE: only move to Week 2 when the dog can do 10+ steps beside you on a slack leash and will whip around on the U-turn cue.

handoffs.task_title: Run Week 2 — pulling work outside + Engage (Level 1)
handoffs.evidence: Weekday evenings: one 10-min loose-leash walk plus one 5-min reactivity session.

handoffs.task_title: Run Week 3 — Disengage (Level 2) and start closing the distance
handoffs.evidence: REACTIVITY, Disengage/Level 2: let the dog notice the other dog, then WAIT 1–5 seconds to see whether it looks away ON ITS OWN.

handoffs.task_title: Run Week 4 — combine, proof, and honestly reassess
handoffs.evidence: Merge both skills on your normal routes: loose-leash game running continuously, and when a dog appears, default to Engage–Disengage at whatever distance you can get.

handoffs.task_title: Optional — book the free 15-min call with D For Dogz as a fallback
handoffs.evidence: Free 15-min discovery call: https://dfordogtraining.com/private-dog-training-silicon-valley/leash-reactive-dog-private-training/
